sentences.en: I know the human being and fish can coexist peacefully.
sentences.zh: 我知道人类和鱼可以和平共存。

sentences.en: Gandhi wanted to make Hindus and Muslims coexist peacefully.
sentences.zh: 甘地希望让印度教徒和穆斯林能够和平共存。

sentences.en: In Algeria, Arabic speakers and Berber speakers coexist peacefully.
sentences.zh: 在阿尔及利亚，阿拉伯语使用者和柏柏尔语使用者能够和平共存。
